text_block_list.name: Biko Pegasus
text_block_list.text:
And then, and then! How've you been doing lately, Sis?
Getting more work as an action actress?

text_block_list.name: Action Actor
text_block_list.text: Ahaha... Well, you see...

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: After such a long time, the two of them enjoyed a leisurely chat and spent the time together.

text_block_list.name: Action Actor
text_block_list.text: "Here I am saying I want to encourage Biko-chan... but things aren't going so well for me either."

text_block_list.name: Action Actor
text_block_list.text:
"They told me 'your action lacks flair.'
And just like always, I keep failing auditions."

text_block_list.name: Biko Pegasus
text_block_list.text:
"Lacks flair," huh?
Hmm, I don't really get it, though~

text_block_list.name: Biko Pegasus
text_block_list.text:
I might be worrying about something similar.
Like, maybe just being strong isn't enough
to be a real hero.

text_block_list.name: Action Actor
text_block_list.text: Just being strong... makes a hero?

text_block_list.name: Biko Pegasus
text_block_list.text:
Yeah, at first I thought if I just got stronger,
I could become a hero! But...

text_block_list.name: Biko Pegasus
text_block_list.text:
Bakushin O-senpai isn't just strong,
she's a model student and super popular.

text_block_list.name: Biko Pegasus
text_block_list.text: So even if I get just as strong, I'm still not acting enough like a hero, huh...

text_block_list.name: Action Actor
text_block_list.text:
I see. She's hilarious and well-loved after all,
Sakura Bakushin O...

text_block_list.name: Action Actor
text_block_list.text:
You'd want to become one, wouldn't you?
Someone who captivates people like that.

text_block_list.name: Biko Pegasus
text_block_list.text:
Yeah, otherwise
you can't really call yourself a hero.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: She was absolutely right. Sakura Bakushin O had no intention of becoming a hero, yet she was undeniably one.

text_block_list.name: Biko Pegasus
text_block_list.text:
"Hey, Trainer. If just training hard isn't enough
to make me a hero, what am I supposed to do?"

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
"If, after doing everything I ought to as an Umamusume with all my might,
I still fall short..."
choice_data_list: Maybe I should reconsider what makes a hero.
Maybe we should reconsider what makes a hero.

text_block_list.name: Biko Pegasus
text_block_list.text: The qualifications... of a hero...

text_block_list.name: Action Actor
text_block_list.text: “You're right. There's definitely something we're lacking right now. We have to figure out what it is.”

text_block_list.name: Action Actor
text_block_list.text: "Biko-chan, could you give me a hand for a bit? With action practice!"

text_block_list.name: Biko Pegasus
text_block_list.text:
Yeah, nice! Let's try all sorts of things!
I wanna learn Carrotman poses and stuff too!

text_block_list.name: Biko Pegasus
text_block_list.text: Here I go, to-ohh!!

text_block_list.name: Biko Pegasus
text_block_list.text:
Full of nutrients! Full of justice!
Carotene charge, Carrotman!!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
First, Biko Pegasus gleefully acted out
her beloved Carrotman.

text_block_list.name: Biko Pegasus
text_block_list.text: Take this, Carrot High Kiiick!

text_block_list.name: Action Actor
text_block_list.text: Huh? What... !?

text_block_list.name: Biko Pegasus
text_block_list.text: How was it, lady? Did my Carrotman impression hit the mark?

text_block_list.name: Action Actor
text_block_list.text:
Yeah, it looked similar.
It looked similar, but...

text_block_list.name: Action Actor
text_block_list.text:
The subtle movements are completely different from how I do it.
Honestly, this might be better...

text_block_list.name: Biko Pegasus
text_block_list.text:
Huh? Mine's better?
I really don't think that's possible, though.

text_block_list.name: Action Actor
text_block_list.text:
No, Umamusume... especially Biko-chan's
physical abilities might really just be on a whole other level.

text_block_list.name: Action Actor
text_block_list.text: Hey, Trainer?
choice_data_list: Yeah, because they trained intensely even before making their debut.
Yeah, because they trained intensely even before their debut.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Yes, that was... back during the
"Open Training" session, if I recall...

text_block_list.name: Biko Pegasus
text_block_list.text: Trainer... Honestly, I still don't have enough skill or running mileage...

text_block_list.name: Biko Pegasus
text_block_list.text:
“B-But if I bust my tail between now
and the open training day,
maybe I can still blow everyone away?!”

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: Aiming to be a hero, Biko Pegasus had undergone an extraordinary amount of rigorous training even before her debut.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: It wouldn't be surprising if the results showed not just in her running, but throughout every fiber of her physical capabilities.

text_block_list.name: Action Actor
text_block_list.text: "If I can incorporate Biko-chan's movements... it might change everything people know about the action industry."

text_block_list.name: Action Actor
text_block_list.text:
It's tough to reproduce with a human body, but
if I can pull it off... it'll start a “revolution”!

text_block_list.name: Biko Pegasus
text_block_list.text: Did you figure something out, Miss?

text_block_list.name: Action Actor
text_block_list.text:
Yeah! Thanks, Biko-chan.
I found it thanks to you!

text_block_list.name: Action Actor
text_block_list.text:
My "criteria for being a hero"!
I'll show you how it's done, so watch me!

text_block_list.name: Action Actor
text_block_list.text:
Here I go!
Spinning 3-Turn, Carrot Kiiiick!!!

text_block_list.name: Biko Pegasus
text_block_list.text:
Whoaaaa...!!
Amazing! You're incredible, big sis!

text_block_list.name: Biko Pegasus
text_block_list.text:
I've never seen a Carrotman like this!
With this...!

text_block_list.name: Action Actor
text_block_list.text:
Yes, honestly, it feels like my body
is going to fall apart, but...
I'll try showing it at the next audition.

text_block_list.name: Action Actor
text_block_list.text:
Thank you, Biko-chan!
Next time, let's find yours.
Your very own "Hero's Condition"!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: And a few days later—

text_block_list.name: Biko Pegasus
text_block_list.text:
Trainer,
what do you think makes someone a hero in my eyes?

text_block_list.name: Biko Pegasus
text_block_list.text: She had that cool Umamusume-style action down, but for me... I need something that's not just about raw strength...

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
When lost... there is nothing to do but return to the origin.
Biko Pegasus's origin is—
choice_data_list: Let's return to Carrot Man once more.

text_block_list.name: Biko Pegasus
text_block_list.text: Into Carrotman...?
choice_data_list: The person you want to become must be right there.
The person you want to become should be right there.

text_block_list.name: Biko Pegasus
text_block_list.text:
The person I want to be...
Right, I want to be like Carrotman!

text_block_list.name: Biko Pegasus
text_block_list.text:
"Carrotman is strong,
never loses heart, and..."

text_block_list.name: Carrotman
text_block_list.text: "No way, as if I'd let myself be beaten! I have comrades who support me, and someone I want to protect!"

text_block_list.name: Biko Pegasus
text_block_list.text:
The friends who support me...
And... the person I want to protect...

text_block_list.name: Biko Pegasus
text_block_list.text:
That's right. A hero isn't strong...
just for the sake of winning.
There's a reason behind that strength.

text_block_list.name: Biko Pegasus
text_block_list.text: In other words—

text_block_list.name: Shinko Windy
text_block_list.text: Ah—! Biko, what are you doing?

text_block_list.name: Biko Pegasus
text_block_list.text: Huh, Windy-senpai?

text_block_list.name: Shinko Windy
text_block_list.text:
This is no time to be playing around out there!
Windy-chan is sick of being a laughingstock,
so do something about it~!

text_block_list.name: Biko Pegasus
text_block_list.text:
Wait, Windy-senpai~.
I was just starting to get it~.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
My train of thought is interrupted by an unexpected intruder.
However—

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: It seemed Biko Pegasus was finally starting to grasp it—what it takes for her to become a hero.

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text:
Well now, thank you so much for coming!
There's something I'd like to discuss with you in private.

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text:
The thought suddenly struck me. Could it be that...
'there are no battles left worth winning?!' I wondered.
Huh, Bakushin O-chan...

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
The upcoming Mile Championship.
Where everyone puts their future path on the line to compete.
